name: Shechem
brief: City in Canaan, later allotted to Ephraim
short: Shechem was a prominent city in Canaan, later allotted to the tribe of Ephraim, and the site of important events in Israel's history (<ref="Gen. 12:6; 33:18-20; Josh. 20:7; 24:1, 25-26; Judg. 9; 1Ki. 12:1, 25; Ps. 60:6; 108:7; Act.7.16">Gen. 12:6; 33:18-20; Josh. 20:7; 24:1, 25-26; Judg. 9; 1Ki. 12:1, 25; Ps. 60:6; 108:7; Act.7.16</ref>).
